data_fields.name: success_roll_range
data_fields.donor_constant: roll 0..99; fail when roll >= chance; chance capped 0..100

data_fields.name: spell_magnitude_floor
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (min and max floored at 1 on the cost path)

data_fields.name: fatigue_term_formula
data_fields.donor_constant: fFatigueBase - fFatigueMult * (1 - cur/max); GMST values not in donor

data_fields.name: magicka_per_intelligence
data_fields.donor_constant: fPCbaseMagickaMult / fNPCbaseMagickaMult (GMST, values not in donor)

data_fields.name: rest_magicka_per_hour_mult
data_fields.donor_constant: fRestMagicMult * Intelligence per hour slept (GMST value not in donor)

data_fields.name: power_reuse_window
data_fields.donor_constant: 24 hours (86400 s), one use per window

best_idea: A cast is one 0..100 roll against a chance built from the caster's own skill margin minus the spell cost, plus willpower and luck, multiplied by a stamina term, and a failed cast still costs the magicka and stamina.
decision_why: The one-roll cast gate with a stamina multiplier gives one visible number per cast and ties specials to stamina (row 3), so take the shape into src/fight/cast-gate.ts; the donor's magnitude resist is broken by a unit error, so fix it to a percent and use one cost function for price and chance.
acceptance: A server test with school skill 50, willpower 50, luck 0, fatigue term 1 and spell cost 20 asserts a 90% success chance; with fatigue term 0.5 it asserts 45%; and a magnitude spell with attribute resist 0 and a roll just under the threshold removes almost all of its magnitude.
